name: What is the process for starting an exterior renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting an exterior renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we conduct an on-site assessment to evaluate your property and gather detailed information. Based on this, we prepare a comprehensive proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and cost. Once approved, we handle permits, material procurement, and then begin the construction phase, keeping you informed throughout. The project concludes with a final walkthrough and cleanup.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, on-site assessment, proposal, permits, construction, and a final walkthrough.
